reason: The README describes an Agent-oriented workflow plugin for discovering, evaluating, comparing, and cautiously adopting external Skills, with read-only assessment and confirmation before risky actions.

summaries.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的外部 Skill 发现、评估、比较与谨慎采用工作流插件。
summaries.en: An AI Agent workflow plugin for discovering, evaluating, comparing, and cautiously adopting external Skills.

capabilities: Discovers and compares external Agent Skills
Reads candidate Skill content in a read-only evaluation process
Assesses suitability and prompt-injection or trust risks
Produces adoption reports and requests confirmation for risky actions
Supports temporary reference and explicitly authorized permanent installation workflows
